hypothesis: The r19 direct 64-bin WKB surrogate is not merely memorizing the three anchor records: full-trace coefficient supervision on a family-balanced fit panel will preserve the <=0.05 error regime on a calibration panel and on a separate confirmation panel opened only after checkpoint selection is frozen.
expected_mechanism: The eikonal retarded phase removes most spatial oscillation from the learned coefficient envelopes, while complete-trace Fourier supervision exposes every stored time. Increasing medium and source coverage should therefore train reusable envelopes rather than record-specific frame fits.

single_conceptual_variable.name: train_record_support
single_conceptual_variable.candidate: 12 fit records per family with separate 12-per-family calibration and confirmation panels

panels.calibration_truth_access: fixed 32-frame checkpoint selection followed by one all-saved report
panels.confirmation_truth_access: opened once at all saved times after checkpoint freeze

primary_metric: maximum all-saved aggregate/family relative-L2 on the frozen 36-record confirmation panel
failure_signal: Any non-finite update, peak CUDA allocation above 4 GiB, missing terminal/checkpoint binding, or any all-saved split/family relative-L2 above 0.05 rejects the hypothesis without opening validation or test_id.

compute_budget.full_run: at most 2000 updates on one RTX 4090 D

rollback: Preserve r19/update_0900.pt and all r21 artifacts; on failure, mark r21 rejected and return to train-only diagnostics.
